This sentence defines the threshold for 'explicit consent' by stating that an absence of consent information does not qualify as such. It establishes a definitional constraint required to interpret the policy in sentence 1 and prevents it from being treated as an explicit 'no'.

This sentence establishes a default state (telemetry enabled) for users outside the EU and specifies the condition under which that default is overridden. It creates a boundary for non-EU users regarding telemetry status.
